note: Measured over web/dist, which is what domebreak.com serves; perf-pass.py budget --write resolves the build directory from the git root and finds the Electron game's dist/ instead, so the figures are taken by hand off the same build a capture is read from. CSS covers both the emitted stylesheets and the one the prerender inlines into index.html. Inter and JetBrains Mono in web/dist/fonts are self-hosted, so the page fetches no font from another origin.
